children: JPMorgan now expects the Reserve Bank of Australia to raise interest rates again this week, citing recent inflation data and commentary from senior RBA officials. The bank has been suggesting that inflation isn't yet under control and there remains work to do, says Ben Jarman, chief economist at JPMorgan. Market pricing toward a further increase in the official cash rate now sits at around 90%. Additional rate hikes after November are unlikely given the weakness in the activity data, but with inflation still too high, the RBA will retain its hawkish bias, Jarman adds.
